csv_scope_of_work: The City of Tukwila ( the City ) is requesting Statements of Qualification (SOQ) from qualified consulting firms with expertise in Civil Engineering Design. The project design work includes utility coordination, design (30%, 60%, 90%, and 100% submittals) to bid-ready documents (Plans, Specifications and Engineer s Estimate); and necessary permitting. The City also reserves the option, at their sole discretion, to award subsequent phases of work through construction to the Consultant selected through this process. Those phases may include Right of Way acquisition, Environmental Permitting, Design Services During Construction, and/or Construction Management. Proposed project scope includes but is not limited to: Reconfigure intersection at S 124th St/50th Place S to remove EB slip lane, establish protected pedestrian facilities on both sides of S124th from 49th to 51st Pl, extend south edge 124th walkways onto 50th Place and transition to existing paths at S 125th, provide new stormwater treatment/rain garden in old slip lane ROW
